people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep; and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father’s.
translations.bsb: Now while Laban was out shearing his sheep, Rachel stole her father’s household idols.
translations.kjv: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father's.
translations.asv: Now Laban was gone to shear his sheep: and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father's.
